type.title: What heats your home?
type.description: Pick the closest match. The next steps only ask what this setup needs.

data_description.heating_type: Not sure? A hot water tank in a cupboard means the first option. Hot water straight from the boiler, no tank, means combi.

boiler.title: Your boiler
boiler.description: How Home Assistant turns the heating on. Both are optional: leave empty if only your TRVs are smart.

data_description.boiler_switch: The relay, smart switch or thermostat that calls the boiler for heating.
data_description.boiler_on_sensor: On while the boiler actually burns. Makes learning and gas figures more accurate.

thermostat.title: Your thermostat
thermostat.description: How Smart Heating should drive it.

data_description.thermostat_style: Setpoint is recommended: if Home Assistant stops, the thermostat keeps the last sensible temperature.

data_description.hot_water_system: Tank: a cylinder in a cupboard (also known as S-plan or Y-plan). Combi: hot water straight from the boiler.
data_description.hw_calling: On while the tank is asking for heat, e.g. its zone valve or programmer channel. Not the boiler running sensor: leave it empty if you don't have a separate signal.
data_description.hot_water_priority: Pause room heating while the tank heats, so showers are ready sooner. Combi boilers do this by themselves.

outside.title: Outside temperature
outside.description: Used to skip heating on mild days, predict tonight and learn how your house holds heat. One of the two is enough.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Optional: a real outdoor sensor. Without one, the weather entity's current temperature is used.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Optional: for window advice (drying the house). Without one, the weather entity's humidity is used.

extras.title: Optional extras
extras.description: All optional. You can add them later in Reconfigure.

data_description.alarm_panel: Alarm armed away, everyone out, or a toggle. Away = heating off, frost protection only.
data_description.night_schedule: A schedule helper. Empty = 22:00 to 07:00, changeable in Configure.

energy.title: Gas use and cost
energy.description: Do you have a smart meter integration (for example Octopus Energy or Glow)? Smart Heating shares the gas between heating, hot water and other use (the hob), learning your boiler's real rates from the meter over the days. Standing charges are left out: only what the heating uses counts.

energy_meter.title: Smart meter
energy_meter.description: The meter covers all the gas in the house: heating, hot water and cooking.

data_description.gas_meter: A running total in kWh or m³, for example Octopus "current accumulative consumption (kWh)". A total that restarts at midnight is fine.
data_description.gas_rate: Optional. A price sensor in £/kWh, for example Octopus "current rate". Each kWh is costed at the rate when it was used.
data_description.gas_price: Used when there's no unit rate sensor, or it is unavailable.

energy_estimate.title: Estimate from the boiler
energy_estimate.description: Gas is estimated while the boiler runs: from the boiler running sensor, or the heating switch or thermostat when there is none. A modulating boiler burns about 70% of its input on average, so that is the starting rate.

data_description.boiler_input_kw: From the boiler's data plate, for example 15 kW.
data_description.gas_price: Your unit rate in £/kWh, without the standing charge.

electricity.title: Electricity use and cost
electricity.description: Do you have a smart meter integration? Smart Heating learns each heater's real draw (for example a 2000 W heater in a half mode) from the meter, and shares the house's electricity between heating and everything else. Standing charges are left out.

data_description.electricity_meter: A running total in kWh, for example Octopus "current accumulative consumption (kWh)". A total that restarts at midnight is fine.
data_description.electricity_rate: Optional. A price sensor in £/kWh, for example Octopus "current rate". Each kWh is costed at the rate when it was used.
data_description.electricity_power: Optional. Live house power, for example Octopus Home Mini "current demand". When a heater switches on or off, the jump in house power tells its real draw within minutes.
data_description.electricity_price: Used when there's no unit rate sensor, or it is unavailable.

electricity_estimate.title: Estimate from the heaters
electricity_estimate.description: Electricity is worked out from each heater's on time and the power set in its room (and its eco power).

data_description.electricity_price: Your unit rate in £/kWh, without the standing charge.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Each Home Assistant area becomes a room, with its thermometer, TRVs or heaters, presence sensors and lights filled in. {count} area(s) found. You can add, remove or adjust rooms any time.

data_description.areas: Untick areas you don't want heated. Gardens are skipped.
data_description.start_mode: Smart Heating learns how each room holds heat in the background either way (steady results in about 4 days to 3 weeks). Watch first: it only decides and logs until you tap Start heating on the card.

abort.already_configured: Smart Heating is already set up.

error.same_as_boiler: This is the boiler's own switch or running sensor. Pick the tank's own signal, or leave it empty.

import_areas.title: Import Rooms From Areas
import_areas.description: Each selected area becomes a room, with its floor, sensors, TRVs, presence sensors and lights picked up automatically. {count} new area(s) are pre-selected; if all areas are already rooms, those are selected instead. Turn on the re-detect option to fix rooms whose thermometer was picked wrongly.

data.refresh_sensors: Re-detect thermometer and humidity sensor for rooms already added

data_description.areas: Each area becomes a room. Gardens are skipped.
data_description.refresh_sensors: Re-pick thermometer and humidity for rooms already added. Other settings kept.

relearn.title: Relearn rooms
relearn.description: Clears what Smart Heating has learned for the rooms you pick, for example after a valve was shut during the heat test or after new windows. They learn again from now (about a day of cooling and 2 h of heating). Heating carries on as usual.

relearn_confirm.title: Relearn these rooms?
relearn_confirm.description: Learned data for {rooms} will be cleared. This can't be undone. Submit to continue, or close this window to cancel.

data_description.baseline_day: Empty rooms never drop below this by day.
data_description.baseline_night: Empty rooms never drop below this at night.
data_description.safety: Frost and damp floor. Always on, even when Off or away.
data_description.season_gate: Automatic heating runs on days when the outdoor average (last 12 h and next 12 h) is below this. UK homes usually need heat below 15.5°. On milder days only rooms in use that are clearly cold heat, and One Cycle and Heat now always work.
data_description.override_hours: How long Heat now / Turn off lasts.

data_description.gas_price: Your unit rate, without the standing charge. With a unit rate sensor, used only when it is unavailable.
data_description.boiler_input_kw: Used when gas is estimated from boiler running time.
data_description.electricity_price: For electric heater costs, without the standing charge.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Who gets phone alerts: learning finished, boiler problems and window advice.

data_description.notify_people: Alerts go to the Home Assistant app on each person's phone. Window advice only goes to people who are at home at the time.
data_description.notify_service: Optional: other targets, e.g. a wall tablet or a Telegram chat. They get every alert, home or not.
data_description.window_alerts: When opening the windows briefly would dry the house, or cool it on a hot day, and when to close them again. Never at night, at most 8 a day.

data_description.hysteresis: Heat starts this far below target. Bigger = fewer burns.
data_description.coast_rate: Rising this fast without heat = wait, don't fire.
data_description.coast_horizon_min: Wait only if target is reached within this time.
data_description.stack_max_wait_min: Longest an upper room waits for heat rising from below.
data_description.trv_open_offset: Open TRV = target plus this. Caps the room if HA stops.
data_description.hw_max_pause_min: Longest heating pauses for hot water.
data_description.mild_margin: On days above the season gate, a room in use heats by itself only when it is this far below its target and not warming on its own.

abort.relearned: Done: {rooms} will learn again from now.
abort.not_loaded: Smart Heating isn't running. Reload it and try again.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Pick the Home Assistant area. Name and floor come from the area.

data_description.area_id: Name and floor come from the area.

data_description.floor: Only asked when the area has no floor.
data_description.priority: A living and sleeping. B occasional. C halls and service.
data_description.comfort: Target while the room is in use.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Head-height thermometer, away from the radiator. Not the TRV.
data_description.trvs: Smart radiator valves. Empty = radiator not controlled.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion. Marks the room in use.
data_description.lights: Light on = room in use, for 30 min max without presence.
data_description.schedule: On = room wanted warm, e.g. bedroom evenings.
data_description.heaters: Smart plugs or smart heaters Smart Heating switches on and off.
data_description.heater_power_w: Full power from the label, e.g. 2000 W. Not needed if the plug measures power.
data_description.heater_eco_power_w: Optional. Used when a smart heater reports eco mode, e.g. 1000 W.
data_description.radiator: Off if this room has only electric heat.

details.title: {area}
details.description:
Floor: {floor}. What we found in this area is filled in; adjust if needed.

Thermometer candidates: {detected}.

data_description.floor: Only asked when the area has no floor.
data_description.priority: A living and sleeping. B occasional. C halls and service.
data_description.comfort: Target while the room is in use.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Head-height thermometer, away from the radiator. Not the TRV.
data_description.trvs: Smart radiator valves. Empty = radiator not controlled.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion. Marks the room in use.
data_description.lights: Light on = room in use, for 30 min max without presence.
data_description.schedule: On = room wanted warm, e.g. bedroom evenings.
data_description.heaters: Smart plugs or smart heaters Smart Heating switches on and off.
data_description.heater_power_w: Full power from the label, e.g. 2000 W. Not needed if the plug measures power.
data_description.heater_eco_power_w: Optional. Used when a smart heater reports eco mode, e.g. 1000 W.
data_description.radiator: Off if this room has only electric heat.

error.no_temperature: Pick a temperature sensor or at least one TRV, so the room has a temperature to work with.
error.already_added: This area is already a room.

options.setpoint: Setpoint: it gets the target temperature
options.relay: On / off: heat at maximum or off

options.boiler_tank: Boiler with a hot water tank

options.estimate: No smart meter: estimate from the boiler

options.heat_now: Start heating now, learn in the background

options.estimate: No smart meter: estimate from the heaters

heat_test.name: Heat test
heat_test.description: Speeds up calibration: gently heats only the rooms that still need heating data (each about 1° warmer, never above 21.5°, usually under 2 h), then lets the house cool. Pause your own heating schedule first.

start.name: Start
start.description: On starts the test, off stops it early.

ignore_automations.name: Ignore other automations
ignore_automations.description: Run even if other enabled automations use the boiler control.

start_control.name: Start heating
start_control.description: Turns Monitor only off so Smart Heating drives the boiler and TRVs. Learning carries on in the background.

relearn.name: Relearn rooms
relearn.description: Clears what Smart Heating has learned for the named rooms; they learn again from now.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names, as shown on the card.

one_cycle.name: One Cycle
one_cycle.description: Heats what needs it once, then switches to Off. With nothing to heat it waits 3 minutes, then Off.

all_rooms.name: Every room below target
all_rooms.description: Also heat empty rooms, from any shortfall, even on mild days.

hw_same_as_boiler.title: Hot water sensor is the boiler's own signal
hw_same_as_boiler.description: The hot water setting uses {entity}, which is also the boiler's switch or running sensor. It says the boiler is running, not that the tank wants heat, so Smart Heating ignores it for hot water priority and the gas split. Open Smart Heating, Reconfigure, and on the Hot water step pick the tank's own signal (zone valve or programmer channel) or leave it empty.

competing_automations.title: Other automations switch the heating
competing_automations.description: These enabled automations also switch the boiler control: {automations}. While Smart Heating is heating, turn them off so they don't fight. Smart Heating backs off when something else switches the boiler, but the house is better served by one controller.

boiler_sensor_silent.title: Boiler running sensor did not respond
boiler_sensor_silent.description: Smart Heating has called for heat for {minutes} minutes, but {sensor} never turned on. Check that the sensor follows the boiler, that nothing else (a room thermostat in series, a timer) blocks the call, and that the boiler has power. This clears itself once the sensor turns on.
